prerequisites: Achievement of the second study section, requiring at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section.
Proficiency in at least one imperative programming language
Confident use of nested loop constructs

learning_outcomes.text: Analyze given algorithms and state their time behavior and memory consumption.
List the most important data structures and describe their advantages and disadvantages.
Select suitable data structures for practical problems.
Identify implementation aspects of algorithms and data structures and describe their effects.
Implement algorithms in an imperative or object-oriented programming language.
Perform runtime measurements for the implemented algorithms and evaluate and present them using descriptive statistics.

assessment_rules: The examination is a 90-minute written test. No further details are provided.
